recipes.title: Crispy Pan-Fried Chicken with Lemon Butter Sauce
recipes.description: Golden chicken thighs in a bright, buttery lemon pan sauce with fresh thyme.
instructions: Pat 4 chicken thighs dry with paper towels and season both sides with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add chicken thighs skin-side down and sear over medium-high heat for 6–7 minutes until skin is golden and crispy.
Flip thighs and cook over medium-high heat for 4–5 minutes until the other side begins to brown.
Transfer chicken to a plate, then reduce heat to medium and add 30g butter and 3 minced garlic cloves to the same skillet.
Add juice and zest from 1 lemon, 120ml chicken stock, and 4 thyme sprigs, stirring over medium heat.
Return chicken to skillet skin-side up and simmer over medium heat for 8–10 minutes until cooked through.
Serve chicken thighs with lemon butter sauce spooned over top.

recipes.title: Beef & Tomato Ragu over Creamy Polenta
recipes.description: Rich, slow-simmered Italian beef ragù served over silky, buttery polenta.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat.
Add 400g minced beef and cook over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes, breaking it apart, until browned.
Stir in 1 diced onion, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 diced carrot, and 1 diced celery stalk and cook over medium heat for 4–5 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp tomato paste and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in 120ml red wine and 250ml beef stock, scraping up browned bits from the pot bottom.
Add 400g crushed tomatoes and 1 bay leaf, then reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 25–30 minutes.
While ragù simmers, bring 500ml milk to a boil in a separate pot over medium-high heat.
Slowly whisk 150g polenta into 500ml simmering milk over medium heat, stirring constantly for 3–4 minutes to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to low and stir polenta for 15–20 minutes until thick and pulls away from the pot sides.
Stir 50g butter and 60g parmesan into polenta, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Season ragù with salt and pepper, discarding the bay leaf.
Spoon creamy polenta into bowls and top generously with beef ragù.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken & Jasmine Rice
recipes.description: Fragrant, aromatic Thai curry with tender chicken and fresh basil in creamy coconut broth.
instructions: Rinse 200g jasmine rice under cold water until water runs clear, then add to a pot with 300ml water.
Bring jasmine rice and water to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low and cover for 15 minutes.
Heat 3 tbsp Thai green curry paste in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring to release aromatics.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 1 tbsp minced ginger to the curry paste and cook over medium heat for 1–2 minutes.
Pour in 400ml coconut milk slowly, stirring constantly over medium heat to combine with the paste.
Add 450g sliced chicken breast and simmer over medium heat for 8–10 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in 1 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp lime juice, and 1 tsp palm sugar, tasting and adjusting over medium heat.
Add 1 sliced green bell pepper and 1 sliced bird's eye chilli, then simmer over medium heat for 3–4 minutes.
Remove curry from heat and stir in 15g fresh Thai basil leaves.
Fluff jasmine rice with a fork and divide between serving bowls, then ladle Thai green curry on top.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu & Broccoli Stir-Fry with Ginger
recipes.description: Golden tofu cubes and charred broccoli tossed in aromatic ginger-garlic sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil over medium-high heat in a large wok or skillet.
Add 400g pressed tofu cubes and sear for 4–5 minutes until golden, stirring occasionally.
Transfer tofu to a plate; add remaining 1 tbsp oil to wok.
Add 400g broccoli florets and stir-fry over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir in 4 minced garlic cloves and 2 tbsp minced ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return tofu to wok; add 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp lime juice, and 1/2 tsp chilli flakes.
Toss everything together for 1 minute, then serve immediately.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower & Chickpea Bowl with Tahini Dressing
recipes.description: Tender roasted cauliflower and spiced chickpeas with greens, pomegranate, creamy tahini drizzle.
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Toss 450g cauliflower florets with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Spread cauliflower on a baking tray and roast at 220°C for 20 minutes until golden and tender.
Meanwhile, toss 400g drained chickpeas with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast on separate tray for 20 minutes until crispy.
Whisk together 3 tbsp tahini, 3 tbsp lemon juice, 1 minced garlic clove, and 1 tbsp warm water until smooth; season with salt.
Divide 150g fresh spinach between two bowls as a base.
Top each bowl with roasted cauliflower, crispy chickpeas, and 40g pomegranate arils.
Drizzle tahini dressing over each bowl and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
recipes.description: Fragrant coconut curry with tender chicken, fresh basil, and vibrant green chilies.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add 3 minced garlic cloves and 3 tbsp green curry paste, stirring constantly over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add 400g chicken breast pieces and cook over medium-high heat, stirring, until sealed on all sides for 5 minutes.
Pour in 400ml coconut milk, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 1 tsp palm sugar, stirring well.
Add 1 sliced onion and 1 sliced red bell pepper, then simmer over medium heat for 12 minutes.
Stir in 2 sliced green chilies and 1 small handful thai basil leaves, then squeeze juice from 1 lime over the curry.
Serve immediately with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Italian Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy arborio rice with earthy mushrooms, white wine, and sharp parmesan.
instructions: Heat 750ml vegetable broth in a saucepan over medium-low heat and keep at a gentle simmer.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then add 300g sliced mushrooms and 2 sprigs thyme.
Cook mushrooms over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden, then set aside.
In the same pan, add 1 tbsp olive oil and cook 1 diced onion and 2 minced garlic cloves over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Add 250g arborio rice to the pan and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes until grains are coated.
Pour 150ml white wine into the rice and stir over medium heat until absorbed, about 2 minutes.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time (about 150ml each), stirring constantly over medium heat for 18 minutes total.
Fold in 50g butter and 80g grated parmesan cheese, then season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Stir the cooked mushrooms back into the risotto and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mexican Chorizo & Black Bean Tacos
recipes.description: Spiced chorizo with cumin-scented black beans, fresh lime, cilantro, and crumbly cotija cheese.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 200g chorizo sausage (casing removed) and cook over medium-high heat, breaking apart, for 5 minutes.
Add 1 diced onion and 2 minced garlic cloves, cooking over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Stir in 400g black beans (drained) and 1 tsp ground cumin, heating over medium for 3 minutes.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Warm 8 corn tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1 minute per side until pliable.
Divide chorizo-bean mixture among tortillas, top with 60g crumbled cotija cheese and cilantro, and serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Stew
recipes.description: Tender beef chunks braised with root vegetables in rich, savory gravy.
instructions: Pat 800g beef chuck cubes dry with paper towels, then coat lightly in 2 tbsp flour seasoned with salt and pepper.
Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Working in batches, sear the beef cubes over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until deeply browned; transfer to a plate.
Add 1 large diced onion, 2 celery stalks, and 3 minced garlic cloves to the pot over medium heat and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened.
Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in 750ml beef broth, scraping up browned bits from the pot bottom, then return seared beef and accumulated juices to the pot.
Add 1 tsp dried thyme, 2 bay leaves, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp black pepper; bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Cover and reduce heat to low; simmer for 50 minutes until beef is very tender.
Add 400g diced potatoes and 300g carrot chunks, stir well, cover, and simmer over low heat for 25–30 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaves, taste, and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper; serve hot in bowls.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry Chicken
recipes.description: Aromatic coconut curry with chicken, bell peppers, and fresh basil.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large wok or pan over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add 3 tbsp Thai green curry paste and cook over medium-high heat for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Pour in 400ml coconut milk, stirring well to combine with the paste, and simmer over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add 400g chicken breast strips and 2 minced garlic cloves; cook over medium heat for 5–6 minutes until chicken is half-cooked.
Stir in 1 tbsp minced ginger, 1 medium sliced onion, and 1 large sliced red bell pepper; simmer over medium heat for 5–7 minutes.
Add 200ml chicken broth, 2 tsp fish sauce, and 1 tsp sugar; simmer over medium heat for 3–4 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Fold in chopped Thai basil and squeeze fresh lime juice over the curry; taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve hot in bowls with steamed jasmine rice and lime wedges on the side.

recipes.title: Crispy Roasted Pork Chops with Thyme Jus
recipes.description: Pan-seared thick pork chops finished in oven, served with pan sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and place a cast-iron or oven-safe pan inside to heat.
Pat 2 pork chops dry with paper towels, then season both sides generously with 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, and 1 tsp dried thyme.
Carefully add 2 tbsp olive oil to the hot pan, then immediately lay pork chops flat and sear over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes until golden.
Flip pork chops and sear the other side over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes until golden.
Transfer the pan with pork chops to the preheated 200°C oven and roast for 8–10 minutes until internal temperature reaches 63°C.
Remove pan from oven and carefully transfer pork chops to a warm plate; tent loosely with foil and rest for 5 minutes.
Place the pan on the stovetop over medium heat; add 1 minced shallot and 2 smashed garlic cloves and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Deglaze the pan by pouring in 120ml chicken broth, scraping up browned bits from the bottom; simmer over medium heat for 3–4 minutes until reduced by half.
Remove from heat and whisk in 1 tbsp butter; squeeze fresh lemon juice into the jus and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Plate pork chops and spoon warm thyme jus over top; serve immediately with roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu & Broccoli Stir-Fry with Ginger-Garlic Sauce
recipes.description: Golden tofu and charred broccoli tossed in aromatic ginger-garlic sauce over rice.
instructions: Press 400g extra-firm tofu between paper towels under weight for 10 minutes to remove moisture.
Cut pressed tofu into 2cm cubes and toss with 1 tbsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Heat 3 tbsp vegetable oil in a large wok or pan over medium-high heat for 1 minute until shimmering.
Add tofu cubes and sear over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden on all sides.
Transfer tofu to a plate, then add 400g broccoli florets to the same pan over medium-high heat.
Stir-fry broccoli over medium-high heat for 4 minutes until bright green and charred at edges.
Add 4 minced garlic cloves and 2 tbsp grated ginger to broccoli, stir over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return tofu to pan with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and 1 tbsp sesame oil, toss over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Serve stir-fry over 1 cup cooked white rice, garnish with 1 tsp sesame seeds and 2 sliced green onions.
